_comment: The notifications package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/seo_analyzer_PRD.md X10). One slot the
application binds in its own security.json, or startup is refused:
Every row is its owner's alone (the Actions classes' row rule), so the slot only says who may use notifications
at all. Notifications: QueryRead + Delete (written by ISparkNotifier, marked read through /spark/notifications/read).
Devices: QueryRead + Delete (subscribed by the browser). Preferences: the user's own, every verb.
